Perennos Tempo 2.1.0 brings the Conductor, Fleet, Crate, voice, Sections and Woodshed features, with the SR-17 room-security fix.

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `PerennosTempo-Setup-2.1.0-x64-source-available.exe` | Windows 10 and 11 (x64) |
| `perennos-tempo-source-available-2.1.0-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` | macOS on Apple silicon |
| `perennos-tempo-source-available-2.1.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` | Linux (x86_64) |
